summary: Frontend-only validation of the two new features (chat attachments on /ceo + Web Push UI on /definicoes). All 6 acceptance criteria PASSED. Login as adminceoai@gmail.com works via 'Entrar' button. /ceo loads with chat-attach-btn / chat-file-input. Image upload (PNG with FATURA/Total 1234.56 EUR) produced a chip in chat-attachments; sending with question 'Que valor total aparece?' streamed a real vision response: 'O valor total que aparece na fatura é 1234.56 EUR' — confirming real vision analysis via gpt-5.4. Text document upload (.txt with ACME LDA / 4321 EUR) produced chip; send-only-with-attachment (no text) works — send btn was enabled and streamed a full CEO analysis referencing 'ACME LDA' and '€4.321'. remove-attachment-<id> correctly clears the chip (count 1→0). /definicoes renders push-card with enable-push-btn and test-push-btn; clicking test-push without subscription produced friendly PT toast 'Nenhum dispositivo subscrito. Ativa as notificações primeiro neste aparelho.' (no crash). Clicking enable-push in headless yields toast 'Permissão de notificações negada.' (expected, no crash). Page stays fully interactive after both clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx handleFiles swallows upload errors silently in a try/catch with empty block (line 67) — user gets no feedback if /chat/attachment fails (e.g. unsupported type, size limit). Consider a toast.error to surface failures.
Chat.jsx does not enforce a client-side max file size before uploading; big files will just spin the loader. Add a size guard + PT warning.

Settings.jsx enablePush relies on Notification.requestPermission() which throws on some older Safari builds — wrapping the whole flow in try/catch is fine, but permission-denied could be distinguished from serviceWorker errors for clearer UX.
test_credentials: adminceoai@gmail.com / 12345 — use 'Entrar' button (not 'Continuar com Google'). Route for Settings is /definicoes (NOT /settings or /personalizacao).
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_fatura.png (PNG with visible invoice text 'Total: 1234.56 EUR') and /tmp/test_doc.txt (ACME LDA invoice 4321 EUR) for the upload flows. Two admin chat sessions were created during the test run — main agent may wish to prune them via del-session UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features are fully functional end-to-end from the UI. Vision (gpt-5.4) truly analyses uploaded images. For push-card testing in headless: expect 'Permissão de notificações negada.' toast on enable and 'Nenhum dispositivo subscrito. Ativa as notificações primeiro neste aparelho.' on test-push — these are the correct friendly PT toasts. Route is /definicoes.
